The '''Kashyyyk skyhook''' underwent construction in [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk's]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] by [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] under the watch of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was anchored to the planet's surface by eight [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor pins]]. The [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhook]] was built for the purpose of shuttling Wookiee slaves into orbit to awaiting Imperial [[Starship/Legends|starships]], which would then ferry the Wookiees throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to Imperial construction projects, including the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. Construction was overseen by [[Ozzik Sturn]], a human [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].

[[Galen Marek|Starkiller]], the secret apprentice of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], was tasked with destroying the skyhook by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] in 2 BBY. He completed this task, killing Sturn and freeing the Wookiee slaves in the process. However, according to Starkiller, the Wookiees who remained on Kashyyyk only saw it to be rebuilt.
